predictions.rationale: Only candidate whose name explicitly references "UseCase". Implements navigation rule from a Use Case to its Extension Points in the Explorer, directly supporting the structure of Use Case diagrams.
Provides notation (textual rendering) for UML Extension Points, one of the core elements that appear on Use Case diagrams, thus directly supporting their visual representation.
Defines explorer rule that maps a UML model to its diagrams, including Use Case diagrams, facilitating navigation and management of those diagrams.
Supports listing of all diagrams (Use Case diagrams among them) under a project node in the Explorer, thereby aiding access to the feature.
Generic diagram-appearance event used by all diagram types, including Use Case diagrams, to notify listeners of visual style changes.
Listener interface paired with ArgoDiagramAppearanceEvent; components specific to Use Case diagrams rely on these callbacks for appearance updates.
Initialises the notation subsystem that supplies textual rendering for all UML diagrams, including Use Case diagram elements such as actors and use cases.
Explorer rule that reveals diagrams (including Use Case diagrams) owned by a namespace, enabling users to locate and open them.
Event representing notation changes; affects how use cases and actors are displayed textually within Use Case diagrams.
UML-specific implementation of Extension Point notation provider, ensuring correct display of this Use Case-related element in diagrams.
